notes: Task A A0 is a seeded random score per candidate; A4 is the algebraic oracle.

A1 is tie-dominated at L9/L11: many candidates share Jaccard=0 with the children, so competition top1 can be 100% while top1_strict is only ~2-8% and MRR_tie is below chance. Use top1_strict / MRR_tie for A1; A3 has tie_rate=0.
Sibling coverage is 0: sampled triads had sibling_mbs=0, not a timeout. The build appears to assign each child to one parent, so this pool is structurally unavailable.
Task B AUC 100% is expected given A4=1.0: the true residual is 0, so it verifies algebraic faithfulness, not the quality of a learned metric.
Task B uses the true triad weights (w1,w2,w3) for both the true and swapped bridge; candidates are weight-band matched.
Lexical pool is one shared random same-level sample per level, ranked per triad (a per-triad resample would only add variance at large BFS cost).
Near/lexical/sibling candidates with cosine > 0.9999 to the true bridge are excluded: the corpus stores some relations twice, and those duplicates are the answer, not negatives.
The distance-matched Task B tier requires |delta cos| <= 0.02 *and* disjoint bridge words; if coverage is low, that is a property of the near neighbourhood, not a silent failure.

Degenerate triads (bridge words subset of children, or Jaccard >= 0.5) are reported in subset=all but excluded from the clean headline. L13 has only 38 clean triads (144/182 are restatements), so L13 clean numbers are low-n.
